SIRUP, the Spatial Immune Receptor Utilities Package, is an R package for
working with spatial adaptive immune receptor repertoire sequencing
(spAIRR-seq) data. It works with B cell receptor (BCR) and T cell receptor
(TCR) sequences that have a spatial barcode, together with spatial gene
expression from the same tissue section. Isn't that sweet?

Full guides, tutorials, and function documentation are at
<https://sirup.readthedocs.io>.
